text: The lift in Tower B stopped between the 7th and 8th floors and there is an elderly lady and a child inside pressing the alarm button. They have been stuck about 10 minutes. I'm calling from Apartment 604, Contoso Heights Tower B. Please hurry.
note: People trapped in a lift: risk to life now.

text: Half the flat lost power this morning and the breaker trips every time I switch it back on. The fridge is off and I have baby milk in it. Unit 1108, Contoso Gardens.
note: Partial power loss with a tripping breaker and food at risk: fix within 24 hours, no immediate danger.

text: المكيف في غرفة الضيوف يطلع صوت خفيف لكنه يبرد عادي. ممكن أحد يفحصه الأسبوع الجاي؟ شقة 905، كونتوسو مارينا.
note: Minor noise from a working AC, resident offers next week: routine.

text: I saw two cockroaches in the kitchen this week, nothing more. Could pest control visit when convenient? Unit 312, Contoso Heights Tower A.
note: Small sighting, no urgency stated: routine.

text: Rats got into the pantry overnight and chewed through bags of rice and flour. We have a newborn at home and I'm worried about food and hygiene. Unit 207, Contoso Gardens.
note: Rodents in food storage with a newborn: a health risk that should not wait for the routine window.

text: My lease expires in four months and I'd like to know when the renewal letter will arrive and what the new rent will be. Unit 1502, Contoso Heights Tower A.
note: Renewal question: routine.

text: My statement shows AED 300 for a pest control visit, but the ants are back in the kitchen already. Why am I paying for something that didn't work? Apartment 806, Contoso Gardens.
note: Primary ask is disputing a charge; the pest problem is real but secondary. A classifier may wrongly pick pest.

text: وصلتني فاتورة هذا الشهر وفيها رسوم ما أعرفها. ممكن توضحون لي إيش هذي الرسوم؟ شقة 1301، كونتوسو هايتس.
note: Question about an unknown charge: routine.

text: We have had no hot water for two days and there are two small children at home. Unit 509, Contoso Marina Residence.
note: Water heater failure: fix within 24 hours, no danger to property.

text: Water is running out from under my neighbour's front door into the corridor and it's flowing toward the lift. I knocked and nobody is home. It's apartment 1010, I'm in 1011, Contoso Marina Residence.
note: Active leak spreading now, property at risk. The category could be argued as common_area because it reaches the corridor.

text: بطاقة الدخول ما عاد تفتح باب المبنى وأنا واقف برا الحين. شقة 718، كونتوسو مارينا.
note: Locked out of the building: fix within 24 hours.

text: I just got home and my front door lock has been forced open with scratches around it. I think someone might still be inside. I'm standing in the corridor. Unit 1203, Contoso Heights Tower B.
note: Possible intruder: risk to life now.

text: The washing machine is leaking water across the kitchen floor. I switched it off and closed the tap but there's a puddle spreading. Unit 604, Contoso Gardens.
note: Landlord-supplied washer leaking; category could be argued as plumbing. Contained by the resident, so urgent not emergency.

text: The light inside the oven has stopped working. Everything else is fine. Unit 1106, Contoso Heights Tower A.
note: Cosmetic fault: routine.

text: The flat below plays loud music until after midnight on weekends. It has been three weekends in a row now. Unit 405, Contoso Gardens.
note: Recurring neighbour noise: routine.

text: There is banging and screaming from the unit above, going on for 15 minutes, and it sounds like someone is being hurt. I have never heard anything like it. Unit 1409, Contoso Heights Tower A.
note: Framed as noise, but it may be a person in danger now: emergency. The category could be argued as access_security.

text: The pool gate lock at Contoso Gardens is broken, ما يقفل، and kids can walk in alone when there's no lifeguard. Please fix it.
note: Child safety hazard in a shared space: fix within 24 hours.

text: Two lights in the basement car park, level B2 near bay 45, are out. Unit 1301, Contoso Heights Tower B.
note: Lights out in a car park: routine.

text: في صوت طقطقة ورائحة حريق من المقبس في غرفة النوم وطلعت منه شرارة. فصلت القاطع. شقة 1107، كونتوسو هايتس.
note: Sparking socket and burning smell: fire risk even though the breaker is off.

text: Two sockets in the living room are a little loose in the wall. Not urgent, whenever someone is free. Unit 218, Contoso Gardens.
note: Loose sockets with no sign of a fault: routine.
